Description: This registry defines messages for NVIDIA platform events.

NVLinkPortHealthStateChanged.Description: Indicates that the NVLink early health state of a port has changed.
NVLinkPortHealthStateChanged.Message: NVLink port '%1' health state changed to '%2' (trigger: '%3').
NVLinkPortHealthStateChanged.Resolution: If health state is Attention, review the AttentionTriggerReason and monitor port performance. Contact NVIDIA support if the condition persists.

Name: NVIDIA Message Registry
